## About
We're the Tire Rack Distribution Center on Long Lake Rd in Roseville. You order your tires, and we have them ready for you to pick up here, or we send them out.
We don't mount or balance tires, so you'll want a local shop lined up for the install. Drivers rate us 4.5 stars across 279 Google reviews.

## Services
- Local pickup: Order ahead and pick up your order yourself in Roseville, with a small discount for doing it.
- Delivered tires: Orders can go out from Roseville to other parts of Minnesota. One customer in Hinckley had theirs arrive in less than a day.

## FAQ
Q: Do you install tires?
A: No. We don't do mounting or balancing here, so plan on having a local shop install your tires.

Q: Can I pick up my tires the same day I order?
A: One reviewer bought two sets online and picked them up in Roseville the same day.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
